subtitle.en: 108 names of Shani Deva, the Lord of Karma who teaches patience
subtitle.te: కర్మాధిపతి, ఓర్పు నేర్పించే శని దేవుని 108 నామాలు

source.en: Navagraha tradition; recited on Saturdays, during Shani dasha and Sade Sati, and on Shani Jayanti
source.te: నవగ్రహ సంప్రదాయం; శనివారాల్లో, శని దశ మరియు సఢే సతి కాలంలో, శని జయంతి నాడు పఠిస్తారు

benefit.en: Reciting the 108 names with devotion is believed to pacify Shani's adverse transits, ease delays and losses, and grant steady patience, discipline and protection.
benefit.te: ఈ 108 నామాలను భక్తితో పఠించడం వల్ల శని ప్రభావం శాంతించి, ఆలస్యాలు నష్టాలు తగ్గి, ఓర్పు శ్రద్ధ కలుగుతాయని నమ్ముతారు.

items.mean_en: Salutations to Shanaishchara, the slow-moving lord Saturn who journeys steadily through the zodiac.
items.mean_te: రాశులలో నెమ్మదిగా సంచరించే శని స్వామికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the calm and peaceful one.
Salutations to the bestower of all that is desired.
Salutations to the refuge of all who seek shelter.
items.mean_te: ఆశ్రయం కోరిన వారికి శరణుడైన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the most venerable and excellent one.
Salutations to the lord of all beings.
Salutations to the gentle and serene one.
Salutations to the one worshipped by the gods.
Salutations to the one who moves through the worlds of the gods.
Salutations to the one seated gracefully on a comfortable throne.
Salutations to the one of beautiful and pleasing form.
Salutations to the one of massive and solid form.
Salutations to the one of imposing and majestic form.
Salutations to the one adorned with heavy ornaments.
Salutations to the one whose body is smeared with thick sandalwood paste.
items.mean_te: ఘనమైన గంధపు పేసరంతో అలరారిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the shining one, luminous like a firefly in the dark.
Salutations to the slow-moving one who is never hurried.
Salutations to the one whose actions unfold slowly and surely.
Salutations to the one whose soul is endowed with noble qualities.
items.mean_te: గొప్ప గుణాలు కల ఆత్మ స్వరూపునికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one whose feet purify all mortals.
items.mean_te: మనుషులను పవిత్రం చేసే పాదాలు గలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the great lord of immense power.
items.mean_te: మహా ఐశ్వర్యం కల ప్రభువైన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to Chayaputra, the son of Chhaya, the shadow goddess.
Salutations to Sharva, revered as an aspect of Lord Shiva.
Salutations to the one who bears the quiver of reed arrows.
items.mean_te: వెదురు బాణాల సంచిని ధరించిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one whose nature is at times moving and at times steady.
items.mean_te: కొన్నిసార్లు చలించేవాడుగా, కొన్నిసార్లు స్థిరంగా ఉండే స్వభావం గలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the restless one who is ever on the move.
Salutations to the one of deep blue complexion.
Salutations to the eternal one who is ever present.
Salutations to the one dark and lustrous like blue collyrium.
items.mean_te: నీలి కట్టిక వలె నల్లని మెరుగు గలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one adorned with blue garments and ornaments.
Salutations to the unwavering one who never abandons his resolve.
Salutations to the one who is to be known through the Vedas.
Salutations to the one who is the very form of destiny, Lord Vidhi.
Salutations to the one who is the very ground on which opposition arises.
Salutations to the one whose nature brings about differences and separation.
Salutations to the one whose body is strong and radiant like a diamond.
items.mean_te: వజ్రం వంటి కఠిన దేహం గలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the giver of vairagya, detachment from worldly bonds.
Salutations to the valiant hero.
Salutations to the one free of disease and fear, who removes them from devotees.
Salutations to the lord who governs the succession of calamities.
items.mean_te: ఆపదల పరంపరకు అధిపతి అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one worshipped by the entire universe.
Salutations to the one whose mount is the vulture.
Salutations to the hidden one, subtle and secret.
Salutations to the one whose body resembles a tortoise.
Salutations to the one of awe-inspiring, unusual form.
Salutations to the one who is often reviled by the world yet bears it all.
Salutations to the one abundant in good qualities.
Salutations to the one who moves through the zodiac in his transit.
Salutations to the one who destroys the root of ignorance.
items.mean_te: అజ్ఞాన మూలాన్ని నాశనం చేసే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who is the form of both knowledge and ignorance.
Salutations to the one who is the cause of long life.
Salutations to the one who lifts devotees out of calamities.
items.mean_te: ఆపదల నుండి విడుదల కలిగించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the great devotee of Lord Vishnu.
Salutations to the one of perfect self-control who commands all.
Salutations to the knower of all the varied scriptures and agamas.
items.mean_te: వివిధ ఆగమ శాస్త్రాలను తెలిసిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one praised by Vidhi, the creator.
Salutations to the one worthy of worship by all.
Salutations to the one of striking, unmatched eyes.
Salutations to the most venerable and excellent one.
Salutations to the one of greatest weight and honor.
Salutations to the one who holds the vajra and the elephant goad.
Salutations to the one whose hands grant boons and fearlessness.
items.mean_te: వరద అభయ ముద్రలతో అనుగ్రహించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one of short and humble form.
Salutations to the one accompanied by his consort Jyeshtha.
Salutations to the most excellent of all.
Salutations to the one who speaks little and with measure.
Salutations to the one whose task is to destroy heaps of suffering.
items.mean_te: కష్టాల సమూహాన్ని నాశనం చేసే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the bestower of nourishment and prosperity.
Salutations to the one who is ever worthy of praise.
Salutations to the one reached through hymns of praise.
Salutations to the one who is won over by pure devotion.
Salutations to Bhanu, the one resplendent like the sun.
Salutations to Bhanuputra, the son of the Sun god.
Salutations to the one of grand and auspicious nature.
Salutations to the one who purifies all.
Salutations to the one who dwells in the sign of Sagittarius.
Salutations to the giver of wealth and riches.
Salutations to the one who wields the bow.
Salutations to the one whose body glows with visible radiance.
Salutations to the one associated with the tamas quality and the dark.
Salutations to the one saluted by all people without exception.
Salutations to the giver of special and distinctive fruits.
Salutations to the lord of those he has brought under his sway.
Salutations to the lord of all living beings.
Salutations to the one who moves through the sky.
Salutations to the lord of the khagas, the birds and celestial movers.
Salutations to the one clad in deep blue garments.
items.mean_te: ఘనమైన నీలి వస్త్రాలు ధరించిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one of firm and unyielding mind.
Salutations to the one praised by the assemblies of the noble.
Salutations to the one who holds the blue royal parasol.
Salutations again to the eternal one who endures through all time.
Salutations to the one beyond all qualities.
Salutations to the one who is the very soul of all qualities.
Salutations to the one free of all ailments and blemish.
Salutations to the one whom the worldly blame but the wise revere.
Salutations to the one ever worthy of salutation.
Salutations to the wise and courageous one.
Salutations to the one of divine luminous body.
Salutations to the one who removes the sorrow of the destitute and distressed.
Salutations to the destroyer of poverty and misery.
Salutations to the one counted among the noble and revered.
Salutations to the fierce one who is stern with the wicked.
Salutations to the one whose deeds are stern and unflinching.
Salutations to the one behind desire and anger in all beings.
Salutations to the one who becomes the cause of discord with spouse and children in difficult times.
items.mean_te: కష్ట సమయాలలో భార్యా పిల్లలతో విరోధానికి కారణమయ్యే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who lovingly nourishes his devotees.
Salutations to the remover of fear from others.
Salutations to the granter of the desired fruits cherished in the hearts of devotees.
items.mean_te: భక్తుల మనోభీష్ట ఫలాలను ప్రసాదించే వానికి నమస్కారం.
